rationale: Resolve whether a real API-built mixed-suffrage cluster can retain obsolete local leader belief while a replacement voter majority commits. This exploration measures VerifyLeader outcome and stale FSM state; it makes no formal violation attribution. The smaller source analysis established callback counting but not this legal-history feasibility.
question: After old leader plus nonvoter are partitioned from two other voters, and those voters elect and apply a new command, can old VerifyLeader succeed before its locally configured lease expires? Observe actual completion, terms, application state and successful peer responses.
